predeclared_competitors.original: Original unchanged 8-wide float64 p=1./(1.+np.exp(-np.clip(u,-35.,35.))), isolated from candidate
predeclared_competitors.portable_candidate: For each exact input float64, clamp [-35,35] with exact input float64 comparisons, Decimal.from_float(exact clamped input), 80-decimal-digit local context exp, p=1/(1+exp(-u)), convert via Python float to nearest binary64; no NumPy exp calls in candidate
predeclared_competitors.independent_higher_precision_reference: Decimal.from_float(clamped original exact binary64), Decimal context 120 digits, exp and sigmoid; convert to nearest binary64; only a higher-precision crosscheck, not independent implementation/math proof
predeclared_competitors.original_70bit_prerecorded_reference: MR34I4 earlier 80-digit Decimal outputs provide external existing exact-sha comparators; full equality checked against reference computed on same frozen original cohort.

acceptance.four_native_workers: Windows x2, Ubuntu x2, each independently original source-clean and exact-protocol anchored
acceptance.source_identity: All 4 original source logit SHA match frozen previous baseline; if any mismatch, fail original-source admission; do not call candidate model portable
acceptance.candidate_repeatability: Binary64 candidate output SHA identical on both OS and all four workers for every cohort
acceptance.precision: Candidate Decimal80 float64 bytes match Decimal120 float64 across frozen 490 examples, or record accuracy NO_GO; Decimal80 same as existing MR34I4 oracle
acceptance.original_semantics: Original NumPy output bytes reported unchanged even if they differ, and exact number of original-vs-candidate ULP differences retained
acceptance.cpu_efficiency: Candidate per-cohort measured isolated CPU cost <= original NumPy isolated CPU cost is needed for no-regression engineering GO; otherwise resource GO=FAIL even if deterministic
acceptance.scientific_model_acceptance: Always NO_GO in this experiment: standalone kernel cannot qualify original learner without separately frozen end-to-end model-specific acceptance

stop_rule: No input retuning, no new seeds, no reruns to select favorable workers, no original Ygg/Minigrid/Pycolab source editing, no original model checkpoint/optimizer updates, no protected unfamiliar third-source first-use or held-dev access.
governance: DRAFT_UNMERGED; original training remains NO_GO; no controller, broker, production, or paid API.
